# D&G Painting and Remodeling

> Painting & remodeling based in Pearland, Texas. D&G Painting and Remodeling paints interiors, exteriors and kitchen cabinets and repairs drywall around Pearland. Reviewers say Daniel's crew shows up on time, matches paint perfectly and cleans up before leaving.

## Services
- Interior painting: Whole homes, single rooms and accent walls, with paint matched to what you have.
- Exterior painting: House exteriors painted with careful prep and a clean finish.
- Cabinet painting: Kitchen cabinets and drawers stripped, sanded and repainted for a fresh look without replacing them.
- Drywall & ceiling repair: Holes, water damage and remodel patches fixed, textured and painted to disappear.
- Doors, decks & patios: Front doors refinished and stained, and pool decks and patios painted.
- Remodel finish work: Drywall, texture and paint to finish off kitchen and home remodels.

## About
D&G Painting and Remodeling LLC is a Pearland painting company owned by Daniel. He and his crew do the work themselves, and Daniel keeps customers updated by text from the first quote to the final walk-through. The crew paints interiors and exteriors, refinishes kitchen cabinets and front doors, paints pool decks and patios, and patches drywall and water-damaged ceilings. They put down floor paper and drop cloths, put furniture back and leave the house clean. Many jobs come from repeat customers, friends and local realtors.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I get a free painting quote in Pearland?
  A: Call or text Daniel at (832) 938-6610, or use the quote form. He comes out to look at the job and gives you a quote.
- Q: How long does a drywall patch and paint take?
  A: Many repairs are done in a day. One customer had holes patched, textured and painted in a single day.
- Q: Can you paint my kitchen cabinets instead of replacing them?
  A: Yes. D&G strips, sands and repaints cabinets and drawers, which customers say refreshes the kitchen for far less than new cabinets.
- Q: Will you protect my floors and furniture?
  A: Yes. The crew lays protective floor paper and canvas drop cloths and puts furniture back when they finish.
- Q: Can you match my existing paint?
  A: Yes. Reviewers say Daniel matched their paint perfectly on repairs.
- Q: Do you work in League City and Friendswood?
  A: Yes. D&G works across Pearland, Friendswood, League City, Manvel and Alvin.
